تستنفدوا (form X)
# تَسْتَنْفِدُوا (tastanfidū) /tas.tan.fi.duː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَنْفَدَ (istanfada)
# تُسْتَنْفَدُوا (tustanfadū) /tus.tan.fa.duː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَنْفَدَ (istanfada)
